parts.text: You are provided with two substances: solid A and solution B. Do the following tests on solid A and solution B. Record all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid A Add about a 5 cm depth of water to the boiling tube containing solid A. Replace the stopper in the boiling tube. Shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid A and form solution A. Divide solution A into two approximately equal portions in one boiling tube and one test-tube.
